_comment: Project Tengen's public community server: somewhere to show the project off, post updates,
take feedback, and give the people building it a private place to work.
The shape follows from that. Everything a visitor sees first is read-only, so the top of the
server reads as information rather than chatter. Conversation is public and open. Development
is private, because half-finished decisions read badly to people who only see the conclusion.
Logs are private too -- bot output is noise to everyone except the person debugging it.
Nothing here deletes. Anything already on the server is left alone.
